title: The Ass and His Masters

full_text:
An ass serving a gardener complained of heavy cabbage loads and prayed for a new master. He was sold to a potter, where he carried heavy clay. Complaining again, he was sold to a tanner.

Seeing the tanner's yard, the horrified ass wept: "I complained of light cabbages and heavy clay, but now I serve a master who will flay my hide after working me to death!"
moral: Discontent with present conditions often trades a bad master for a far worse one.
